tools.name: duckduckgo_search
tools.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo and return ranked results with title, direct URL, and a text snippet for each. Use this to find current information, look up facts, or discover resources on any topic. Supports search operators: 'site:example.com' to restrict to a domain, '"exact phrase"' for literal matches, and '-word' to exclude a term. For reading the full content of a result page, use page_fetch with the returned URL.

query.description: The search query, e.g. 'rust async vs threads performance'

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, min: 1, max: 10)
